title: In- and Out-of-Distribution Generalization of Reasoning in Multimodal LLMs for Simple Visual Planning Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2602.15460v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Integrating reasoning in (multimodal) large language models has recently led to significant improvement of their capabilities. However, generalization in reasoning models is still vaguely defined and poorly understood. In this work, we present an evaluation framework to rigorously examine how well chain-of-thought (CoT) approaches generalize in simple visual planning, specifically on a grid-based navigation task. The versatility of the task and its data allows us to fine-tune model variants using different input representations (visual and textual) and CoT reasoning strategies, and systematically evaluate them under both in-distribution (ID) and out-of-distribution (OOD) test conditions. Our experiments show that the out-of-distribution generalization (e.g., to larger maps) is largely impacted by the format used for input maps and CoT chains. translated_title: 多模态大语言模型在简单视觉规划任务中推理的分布内与分布外泛化研究
translated_abstract: 将推理能力整合到（多模态）大语言模型中，近期已显著提升了其能力。然而，推理模型的泛化仍然定义模糊且缺乏深入理解。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个评估框架，以严格检验思维链方法在简单视觉规划中的泛化能力，具体针对基于网格的导航任务。该任务及其数据的多样性使我们能够使用不同的输入表示（视觉和文本）以及思维链推理策略来微调模型变体，并在分布内（ID）和分布外（OOD）测试条件下对其进行系统性评估。我们的实验表明，分布外泛化（例如，推广到更大的地图）在很大程度上受到输入地图和思维链所用格式的影响。令人惊讶的是，我们发现结合文本描述的基于坐标的推理轨迹……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个评估框架，系统检验多模态大语言模型的思维链推理在网格导航任务中的分布内与分布外泛化能力，发现输入地图格式与思维链格式对分布外泛化影响显著，且基于坐标的推理轨迹表现出令人惊讶的泛化效果。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an evaluation framework to systematically examine the in-distribution and out-of-distribution generalization of chain-of-thought reasoning in multimodal LLMs on grid-based navigation tasks, finding that the format of input maps and CoT chains largely impacts OOD generalization, with coordinate-based reasoning traces showing surprisingly strong effectiveness.
